title: 第20章 我的九个妹妹惹人怜爱
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “姐姐，是谁来了呀？”院子里的动静惊动了里屋的人。一个清脆悦耳的童声从里屋响起。只见破旧的木门被轻轻一推，吱呀一声响，大门缓缓被打开。一个小脑袋怯生生地探了出来。接着是第二个、第三个...……不一会儿，九个瘦瘦小小的女孩排着队走了出来，站在屋檐下，她们的脸上有惊喜，但更多的是一丝胆怯，就像一群受惊的小麻雀。如此一幕让辰楠有些愣神。这就是他的九个妹妹。可是，她们似乎有点害怕自已？？？辰楠的脑海中突然闪过一些记忆碎片——原主每次回乡，都对这群妹妹爱答不理、非打即骂、嫌她们吵闹，甚至还骂过她们是“赔钱货”。难怪妹妹们看见他，都是一副想靠近又不敢的模样。站在最前面的是大妹招娣，十二岁的年纪，却瘦弱得像根豆芽菜，身上的衣服打了好几个补丁，但洗得干干净净。她小心翼翼地护着身后的妹妹们，眼神里既有见到哥哥的欣喜，又带着几分胆怯。站在最前面的是大妹招娣，她旁边的是幺妹胜娣。（寓意胜弟，当年爸妈想要生一个男孩陪伴辰楠，看起的名字就知道，每个妹妹的名字都带有一个娣，可一连生到第十个还是女娃，最后只好放弃生男娃的念头，幺妹取名胜娣，希望不是女孩也能胜过男孩，反正都是他们的孩子，他们也不会重男轻女。）幺妹才四岁的小丫头，扎着两个歪歪扭扭的小辫子，正怯生生地咬着手指头，一双大眼睛好奇地望着辰楠。看着这一张张稚嫩的小脸，单薄的身子，严重的营养不良。这几个妹妹就没有一个是壮实的，估计一阵风就能把她们吹倒，辰楠看得心里一阵酸楚。多可爱的妹妹们啊，原主怎么就不知道珍惜呢？他差点没忍住给自已几个大嘴巴子。妹妹们的年纪相隔一年，老妈还真是厉害，九年期间连续生九个娃。谁家有那么强大的身体与生育能力，想到这里，辰楠就特别佩服李秀兰。“不认识哥哥了？”辰楠努力让自已的声音听起来更温柔，“都过来，哥给你们带了好吃的。”妹妹们面面相觑，最后还是招娣壮着胆子，牵着幺妹的手，慢慢走了过来。其他妹妹见状，也小心翼翼地跟在后面。辰楠蹲下身，朝最小的胜娣张开双臂：“来，让哥哥抱抱。”小丫头怯生生地看了看招娣，见大姐轻轻点头，这才迈着小短腿扑进辰楠怀里。辰楠一把抱起幺妹，感觉怀里的小身子轻飘飘的，心里又是一阵发酸。他眉头微微一皱，“怎么那么轻？以后多给你们弄些吃的回来补补身子。”“大妹，来，把这个分给妹妹们。”辰楠从麻包袋里掏出一整包大白兔奶糖，递给站在最前面的招娣。妹妹们看到那么大一包大白兔奶糖顿时眼睛都亮了。她们就见别人吃过，只能闻一下味道。以前爸妈寄东西回来都是一些米面一类的食物，吃零嘴的机会可是屈指可数。“真的给我们吃吗？”招娣小心翼翼地接过糖，感觉不太真实，这还是那个不喜欢她们的哥哥吗？其余妹妹也是眼巴巴地看着辰楠，这些糖都是给她们的？“肯定是给你们吃的。”“哥哥那么大的人不吃糖，这糖都是你们的。”辰楠认真地说着，妹妹们真是太懂事了。妹妹们听到这话眼睛一下子亮了起来，但很快又恢复了懂事的神情，不过她们的嘴角都翘了起来。“太浪费了，这得换多少粮食啊！”奶奶一脸心疼，这日子不过了？竟然敢买一大包大白兔奶糖当零嘴。这年代谁敢一买就买一大包大白兔奶糖的？供销社一包大白兔奶糖将近两块钱一斤，可大米也才一毛多钱一斤。这一包大白兔奶糖换成大米的话，可以换接近二十斤，换成棒子面则更多。辰楠笑了笑没说话，对于奶奶的唠叨他不知如何回答，等以后他们习惯了就好吧。奶奶还想说些什么，但却被爷爷说了句“儿孙自有儿孙福”给制止。“谢谢哥哥。”招娣见爷奶也不说话，她这才敢打开包装，先给爷爷奶奶各分了两棵颗，又给辰楠两棵颗，然后才给妹妹们每人发了一颗。最后看着手里还剩下的大半包糖，仔细地把包装重新折好。“怎么不分完？“辰楠柔声问。招娣仰起小脸，很认真地说：“哥，这是大白兔奶糖，可金贵了。剩下的留着以后慢慢吃。”这话听得辰楠心头一颤，多么懂事的孩子啊，这哪像十二岁娃娃能想到的？他看着招娣消瘦的小脸，明显营养不良的模样，暗下决心以后一定要多给妹妹们弄些肉补补身子。“你们看看哥哥对你们多好！”“以后都要记得哥哥的好，知道吗？”奶奶还是忍不住对着那么多孙女喊了一句。“知道了奶奶。”妹妹们如小鸡啄米般不断点头。“吃吧，哥有钱，以后想吃什么哥都给你们买。”辰楠说着，突然剥开自已那颗糖，塞进了怀里幺妹的嘴里。小丫头先是愣了一下，随即眼角笑弯成了月牙，甜得直往哥哥怀里钻。“甜！哥哥甜！”其他妹妹们看着幺妹吃得香甜，都忍不住咽了咽口水，但手里还紧紧攥着那颗糖，舍不得吃。“你们都吃吧，”辰楠对妹妹们说，“哥以后还给你们买，多着呢。”妹妹们你看看我，我看看你，最后在辰楠鼓励的目光下，一个个小心翼翼地剥开糖纸，把奶糖放进嘴里。院子里顿时响起一片幸福的咂嘴声。爷爷奶奶看着这温馨的一幕，相视而笑。奶奶更是难得地露出了慈祥的笑容。这时辰楠才想起母亲准备的东西，赶紧从麻包袋里往外拿：“爷，奶，这是我妈让捎来的。“他先后拿出了十几斤白面、一块腊肉、一小袋大米、一些小麦和一瓶油，还有其他一些生活用品。这些都是李秀兰省吃俭用攒下来的，每个月都会托人捎回来一两次。二老看着这些东西，欣慰地点点头。奶奶一件件接过去，往厨房里搬。招娣想要帮忙，却被奶奶拦住了：“不重，奶奶自已来就行。你陪着哥哥说说话。”平时都是她做饭，东西放哪儿都是她统一规划。这些粮食平日里很是金贵，但与那头大野猪一比，反倒不算什么。不过老两口心里还是暖暖的，这说明城里的儿子儿媳一直惦记着他们。
content_en: "Sister, who is here?" The movement in the yard alerted the people in the back room.A clear and sweet child's voice sounded from the back room.I saw the old wooden door being pushed gently, and with a creaking sound, the door was slowly opened.A little head poked out timidly.Then came the second, third... After a while, nine skinny little girls lined up and walked out, standing under the eaves. There was surprise on their faces, but more of a hint of timidity, like a group of frightened little sparrows.Such a scene made Chen Nan a little stunned.These are his nine sisters.However, they seem a little afraid of themselves???Some memory fragments suddenly flashed through Chen Nan's mind - every time the original owner returned to his hometown, he ignored these girls, beat them and scolded them, thought they were noisy, and even called them "losers".No wonder the sisters looked like they wanted to get close to him but didn't dare when they saw him.Standing at the front was the eldest sister Zhaodi, who was twelve years old but as thin as a bean sprout. Her clothes had several patches, but they were clean.She carefully protected the sisters behind her, her eyes showing both the joy of seeing her brother and a bit of timidity.Standing at the front is the eldest sister Zhaodi, and next to her is the younger sister Shengdi.(It means Brother Sheng. Back then, her parents wanted to have a boy to accompany Chen Nan. As you can see from the names, each sister’s name has a name of Di. However, after the tenth child was born, she was still a girl. In the end, she had to give up the idea of having a boy. The younger sister was named Sheng Di. HopeI hope even a girl can beat a boy.They are their children anyway, and they will not favor boys over girls.) Yaomei, a four-year-old girl with two crooked pigtails, was timidly biting her fingers and looking at Chen Nan curiously with her big eyes.Looking at these young faces, thin bodies, and severe malnutrition.None of these sisters were strong, and a gust of wind would probably blow them down, which made Chen Nan feel sad in her heart.What lovely sisters, why doesn’t the original owner know how to cherish them?He almost couldn't help but give himself a few big mouths.The sisters are one year apart in age, but my mother is really amazing. She gave birth to nine babies in a row in nine years.Who has such a strong body and fertility? Thinking of this, Chen Nan especially admired Li Xiulan."Don't you know brother?" Chen Nan tried hard to make her voice sound gentler, "Come here, brother has brought you delicious food." The sisters looked at each other, but Zhaodi finally plucked up the courage, held Yaomei's hand, and walked over slowly.Seeing this, the other sisters followed cautiously.Chen Nan knelt down and opened his arms towards the youngest Sheng Di: "Come, let me hug you." The little girl looked at Zhao Di timidly, and when she saw the elder sister nodded lightly, she jumped into Chen Nan's arms with her short legs.Chen Nan picked up Yaomei, feeling the lightness of her little body in her arms, and felt sore in her heart again.He frowned slightly, "Why is it so light? I'll get you some more food to replenish your health later." "Sister, come on, give this to the sisters." Chen Nan took out a whole pack of White Rabbit toffee from the sack and handed it to Zhaodi, who was standing at the front.When the sisters saw such a big pack of White Rabbit toffees, their eyes lit up.They had only seen others eat it and could only smell it.In the past, the things my parents sent back were mostly rice and noodles, and there were only a handful of opportunities to eat snacks."Are you really giving it to us?" Zhao Di took the candy carefully, feeling unreal. Is this still the brother who doesn't like them?The other sisters also looked at Chen Nan eagerly. Are these candies for them?"It must be for you." "People as big as brother don't eat sweets, so these sweets belong to you." Chen Nan said seriously, the sisters are so sensible.The sisters' eyes suddenly lit up when they heard this, but they quickly returned to their sensible expressions, but the corners of their mouths turned up."It's such a waste. How much food will we have to exchange for this!" Grandma looked distressed. Is this going to last?How dare you buy a big bag of White Rabbit toffee as a snack.Who dares to buy a big pack of White Rabbit toffees in this day and age?A pack of White Rabbit toffee from the supply and marketing cooperative costs nearly two yuan per catty, but rice only costs more than ten cents per catty.If you replace this pack of White Rabbit toffee with rice, you can exchange it for nearly 20 pounds, and if you exchange it with stick noodles, it will be even more.Chen Nan smiled and said nothing. He didn't know how to answer his grandma's nagging. He would just wait until they get used to it.Grandma wanted to say something else, but Grandpa stopped her by saying, "Children and grandchildren will have their own blessings.""Thank you, brother." Zhao Di didn't say anything when she saw her grandparents, so she dared to open the package and gave two pieces to each of her grandparents, then two to Chen Nan, and then gave one to each of her sisters.Finally, I looked at the half-pack of sugar left in my hand and carefully folded the package again."Why don't you finish dividing them?" Chen Nan asked softly.Zhao Di raised her little face and said seriously: "Brother, this is the White Rabbit toffee, but it is expensive. Save the rest and eat it later." Chen Nan's heart trembled when he heard this. What a sensible child, how can this be thought of by a twelve-year-old?He looked at Zhaodi's thin little face, obviously malnourished, and secretly determined to get more meat for his sisters to replenish their bodies in the future."Look how good my brother is to you!" "You must remember how good your brother is in the future, you know?" Grandma still couldn't help shouting to so many granddaughters."I know, grandma." The sisters nodded like chickens pecking at rice."Eat, brother is rich, I will buy you whatever you want to eat in the future." Chen Nan said, suddenly peeled off his candy and stuffed it into the mouth of Yaomei in his arms.The little girl was stunned for a moment, then the corners of her eyes turned into crescent moons with a smile, and she was so sweet that she went straight into her brother's arms."Sweet! Sweet brother!" The other sisters couldn't help but swallowed when they saw Yaomei eating sweetly, but they still held the candy tightly in their hands and were reluctant to eat it."You all eat it," Chen Nan said to the sisters, "Brother will buy it for you in the future. There will be plenty." Sisters, you looked at me and I looked at you. Finally, under Chen Nan's encouraging eyes, they carefully peeled off the candy wrapper one by one and put the toffee into their mouths.There was a happy smacking sound in the yard.The grandparents looked at this heartwarming scene and smiled at each other.Grandma even showed a rare kind smile.Only then did Nan remember what his mother had prepared, and quickly took it out of the sack: "Master, milk, this is what my mother asked me to bring." He successively took out more than ten kilograms of white flour, a piece of bacon, a small bag of rice, some wheat, a bottle of oil, and other daily necessities.These were saved by Li Xiulan frugally, and she would ask someone to bring them back once or twice a month.The second elder looked at these things and nodded happily.Grandma took them one by one and moved them into the kitchen.Zhaodi wanted to help, but was stopped by her grandma: "It's not serious, grandma can come by herself. You talk to your brother." She usually cooks, and she plans where everything is placed.This food was usually very valuable, but compared with that big wild boar, it was nothing.However, the old couple still felt warm in their hearts, which meant that their son and daughter-in-law in the city were always thinking about them.
